title: w:hideMark drops the cell's last paragraph when it is empty (line and space-after), after content too; earlier and leading empties keep their line
source: hidemark_trail.docx/.pdf (Letter 0.5in margins, Calibri 11 after=0 line=240 unless noted, 1-row tables sz=4 borders, cell margins 0), Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf top/bottom rule distance per table

cases.note: H_T: hideMark, one text line: Calibri 11 line 13.44 + 0.48 border
H_TE: hideMark, text + trailing empty paragraph: the empty mark line is dropped
H_TEE: hideMark, text + two trailing empties: only the LAST one collapses
H_ET: hideMark, leading empty + text: the leading empty keeps its line
N_TE: no hideMark, text + trailing empty: both lines
N_T: no hideMark, one text line
H_TEa: hideMark, trailing empty with after=160: line and after both dropped (0.24 grid noise)
H_TaE: hideMark, text after=160 + trailing empty: the text paragraph keeps its own after
H_TaEa: hideMark, both after=160: only the text after survives
N_TaEa: no hideMark, both after=160: 2 lines + 2 afters
H_TET: hideMark, interior empty between two text paragraphs keeps its line
H_E: hideMark, lone empty paragraph collapses to the border (Chromium keeps the two 0.5px rules: 1.5pt)
H_TE28: hideMark, trailing empty with a 14pt mark: still dropped
H_TTE_TET: two hideMark cells TTE | TET: the TET cell (3 lines + 3 afters) sets the row
H_TTE_T: two hideMark cells TTE | T: 2 lines + 2 afters, the trailing empty is gone
